notes.title: Patch 1.51: Small optimizations and shadow improvements
notes.content:
Improvements:
 Fixed vegetation shadows not appearing correctly on Kilmore Farm level
 Improved the shadows on guns on the Weapon Rack.
 Slight optimizations to the Kilmore Farm level and Weapon Rack


If you experience any bugs or need assistance with the game, please let me know on Discord or the Steam Discussion Forum. Coop partners (via Steam Remote Play Together) can also be organised on the official Discord channel.

notes.title: Steam Ultimate Edition - Trading Cards, Achievements and more
notes.content:
Steam Trading Cards:

Frontline Zed Trading Cards are now available!

As you play through the game, you will automatically earn Trading Cards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/a8a908a5e26679600741a4f2a2153e9b393eb75a.png
By trading with other users to collect the whole set of six cards, you can then unlock unique Frontline Zed badges, emoticons, and profile backgrounds to enhance and level up your Steam Community profile.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/6af8d3a526b71ef71d0530c92d60acf30c9b1d44.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/7053f8821dedb82778c0363584b2c6a0a2297cc3.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/b0771c040866f3b7b098e320e11d805f5842e129.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/9eea7982847d0066a56d2adf43840237a545964c.jpg


Optimization and Improvements:
 Faster Weapon Switching - Switching time reduced from 2.8 seconds to 1.8 seconds, with an updated and improved animation. Changing to a pistol is also faster than switching to a rifle.

 Survivor Enemy Detection - Survivors will more reliably target enemies that are attacking the barricade when not directly in front of them.

 Performance Optimisation - 5-10% FPS increase from improved GPU instancing.


9 New Achievements:

 Marksman - Get 500 Headshots

 Hoarder - Accumulate 4 Barrels and 4 Grenades

 Full Auto Full Awesome - Kill 20 Zombies with the AA12 Shotgun

 Splash Damage - Kill 5 Zombes with one Grenade

 3 in a Row - Kill 3 Zombies with one L96 Bullet

 Hazard Team - Kill 3 HAZMAT Zombies

 Megaton - Use 3 Grenades in one night

 Going all out - Allocate 4 Barrels in one Night

 Two Against the World - Finish 2 player coop in NewGame+


All Achievements can be viewed here


Other Tweaks and FIxes:
 Fixed blue texture on Security zombie

 Reduced L96 damage from 235 to 200, Rate of Fire from 2.1 to 2.3. This still allows the weapon to one-shot all zombies except Military zombies, which require headshot placement.

 Moved L96 looting location to Military level from an earlier level for NewGame+

 Added a recommendation to play Coop mode in 'Hard' difficulty to the Main Menu UI when starting that mode.


If you experience any bugs or need assistance with the game, please let me know on Discord or the Steam Discussion Forum. Coop partners (via Steam Remote Play Together) can also be organised on the official Discord channel.

If you're an established content creator, media keys are available via Woovit.


A note for Returning Players:
If you last played a much earlier version (1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3), you will need to start a new campaign, and confirm and hit apply to your graphics and gameplay settings in the Options menu. 

If you need to reset all your settings to default, you can delete your save folder located at 
C:\\Users\\**USERNAME**\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Volcanic Games\\Frontline Zed

Please restart your Steam client to receive the update. Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.41 now live - more Optimisation (+1.41A)
notes.content:
Update 1.41 is now live which delivers a 5-10% FPS increase.

GPU Instancing functionality has been improved for many environmental objects, and zombies.

If you experience any bugs or need assistance with the game, please let me know on Discord or the Steam Discussion Forum.


Patch 1.41A:

Fixed weapons getting stuck when rapidly switching between weapons.

notes.title: Update 1.4: CrimPlex Prison Complex - New Weapons, Extended Campaign, 21:9
notes.content:
New Features:
 CrimPlex Prison Complex - take a new path through Stanton City and fight through the CrimPlex Prison Complex, set across two new maps. Collect two powerful new weapons, including the fully-automatic AA12 shotgun.

The CrimPlex campaign path is available in both regular and NewGame+ game modes, including Coop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/2ca33f422221eb6c61ad7921c608024830e40f9b.png

 SCAR - Find the new SCAR weapon in CrimPlex West. The SCAR has fully automatic fire, 30 round magazine, and much higher accuracy than the AKM, but slightly lower damage.

 AA12 - With fully automatic fire and a 10 round magazine, this shotgun is great at clearing out hordes of weaker zombies. However, its limited accuracy will make headshots - particularly against armored zombies - more difficult. The AA12 can be found in CrimPlex East.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/a23ac476029dfda0648d53ace15c858aa302762e.jpg

 Full UltraWide 21:9 Support - all 16 levels of the game have been updated to support UltraWidescreen 21:9 Resolution. This aspect ratio and the associated resolutions can be selected in the Options menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/a1eec3ec054b93d74fc634b1ef54070948db3d5f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/1e2ec47b2153908b4ed3ab548d261db5f4651c86.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/c65e9dbc10051e5d1d1ab072ced0eca48bc3493d.png

 Spanish Localisation - Spanish Localisation has been added.


Additional New Features and Optimisations:
 New Achievement: Prison Break.
 Optimised various zombie meshes and textures.
 Relit the Factory level 


Bug Fixes:
 Fixed being unable to access the regular game mode after completing NewGame+.
 Fixed the Vector firing 9 shots in a burst when used by a survivor.


Balance:
 Increase Chainsaw damage by 10%.
 Increased S12K capacity to 5 shots, slightly reduced damage.


Given the changes to the campaign, it is suggested to start a new game.

If you experience any bugs or need assistance with the game, please let me know on Discord or the Steam Discussion Forum. I'll be standing by to issue a patch in a few days to correct any bugs and make balance tweaks based on suggestions.

If you're an established content creator, media keys are available via Woovit.

Please restart your Steam client to receive the update. Enjoy!


Hotfix 1.40A:
 Fixed zombies running into glass window on ZiGen West level due to improper Navmesh settings.

notes.title: Update 1.3: New Weapons, New Levels, New Enemies, NewGame+. Now Live.
notes.content:
Update 1.3 for Frontline Zed is now available:

New Features:
 ZiGen Science Facility and Branching Campaign - take a detour through Georgetown and travel through the ZiGen Science Facility, split across two new maps. Collect two unique new weapons, and fight against infected HAZMAT and Scientist zombies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/8437caa856756886e34cbc51c096be4a7c66dcf3.png

 SPAS-15 - This new shotgun reloads and shoots fast, but at the cost of slightly lower damage. Find the SPAS-15 on ZiGen East.

 Vector - Find the new Vector weapon in ZiGen West. The Vector packs a 3 round burst and good accuracy, though slightly lower per-shot damage compared to the UZI and UMP.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/a65377763fb73976d34baedeb7606baf5f2c98cf.png

 NewGame+ - Unlock this new mode after finishing the original campaign. Rapidly unlock powerful weapons, and fight against an even bigger and stronger horde. Includes an early access preview of two of the new weapons coming in Update 1.4 - see if you can find them!

 New Visual FX - stray bullets will now strike and impact metal, concrete, rubber, glass, and wood surfaces. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/2a168e964ab9439d03c9dc3ee27ad245a0806bfa.gif


Additional New Features:
 New Achievement: Complete NewGame+
 New Achievement: Survive ZiGen Labs
 New Achievement: Shoot or Explode a Zombie over the railing on ZiGen East
 The player is now prompted to reduce difficulty if they die multiple times on the same level.
 Added a third weapon rack to accomodate the new and future weapons.
 The game will be slightly easier if the player has 1 survivor or less, to minimise death looping.
 Can turn Zombie ragdoll shadows on or off in the Options menu (defaults to off).


Bug Fixes:
 Fixed barrel selection UI not showing on 21:9 monitors
 Fixed barrels not appearing when selected for a second night after being destroyed on the first night
 Fixed missing characters for some languages (like French).


Optimisation:
 Reduced game build size by about 2GB by optimising UI and Barricade textures
 Reduced hitches and improved performance by replacing the custom (Alembic) barricade system with a standard rigged and animated barricade.
 Optimisations to various levels to reduce some unnecessary polygons from background objects.
 Disabled muzzle flash shadows to improve performance. Will be re-added to 'high' quality mode in a future update.


Given the changes to the campaign, you will need to start a New Game - this Update is not save game compatible.

If you experience any bugs or need assistance with the game, please let me know on Discord or the Steam Discussion Forum. I'll be standing by to issue a patch in a few days to correct any bugs and make balance tweaks based on suggestions.

If you're an established content creator, media keys are available via Woovit.

Please restart your Steam client to receive the update.

Patch 1.31:
 Reduced weapon switching time for all weapons by 1.5 seconds.
 Fixed Dangerous Work Environment Achievement.
 Fixed Can't Touch This Achievement.
 Fixed bug which reduced difficulty for Coop mode, which was only meant to apply in Single Player when the player had 1 or no survivors.
 Increased zombie health by 15% in coop mode.

notes.title: Update 1.22 - Partial Ultra-Widescreen Support, Bug and Balance Fixes
notes.content:
Patch 1.22 is now available:

New Features:

 Added 21:9 aspect ratio selection to Options
 Added 1920x800, 2560x1080, 3440x1440 resolutions
 Menus and Weapon Rack have been updated to work with 21:9 monitors.
 Ingame levels have black bars on either side to replicate 16:9 aspect ratio. An update for all levels to be viewable with 21:9 is planned for Update 1.4.
 Added a confirmation prompt/timer when changing graphical settings.

Bug FIxes:

 Changed the physics setting on explodable barrels so that they are less likely to fall through the terrain.

Balance Changes:

 Reduced zombie runner health to 90% of regular health (Zombies that start running after they have already spawned are still at full health)
 Slightly increased survivor weapon accuracy
 Increased the reload animation speed for Snub, Luger, G17, Revolver, M38, Sawn-Off, Uzi by about 10% and updated the reload sounds accordingly
 Reduced the health of early game heavy zombie variants from 190 to 185
 Increased holster and unholster (change weapon) speed when using a pistol by 10%
 Made the Chainsaw damage hitbox longer


Please restart your Steam client to receive the update.

As always, please let us know on Discord or the Steam Discussion Forum if you experience any problems or have any feedback.

notes.title: Update 1.21 - Balance Tweaks
notes.content:
This patch includes some minor balance tweaks:


 Reduced the number of heavy and aggro zombies that spawn on Parking map
 Reduced the overall number of zombies which spawn on Parking map
 Dynamic Difficulty spawns in Zombies more slowly after a player death
 Increased Survivor weapon accuracy


As always please let us know via Discord or the Steam Discussion Forum if you have any feedback or need assistance.

notes.title: Update 1.2: Chainsaw, Explosive Traps, Survivor Weapons (+1.21)
notes.content:
Update 1.2 for Frontline Zed is now available:

New Features:
 Chainsaw - Find the new Chainsaw weapon on Level 3, Jim's Junkyard. The chainsaw makes a useful backup weapon, for clearing out multiple enemies at your barricade. The Chainsaw cannot be equipped by survivors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/61af93dec3e484fc9ea585e4a35e5c0bbed68ad2.png

 Explosive Traps - as you progress through the game, you'll begin to collect explosive traps, which can be activated at the beginning of each new night. Any unused traps will be returned to your inventory. Activated traps need to be shot to explode, and take a few hits before they do - time your shots carefully to align with big zombie waves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/713bd30b47e629e6768d0b8ce8bd3811bfee9b97.png

 Survivor Weapon Allocation - you can now allocate weapons to your survivors at the start of each night. When selecting your loadout from the Weapon Rack, the first two weapons you select will be yours, and the next weapons you select will be equipped by any survivors you have available. Weapons selected for you will be marked in red, and weapons selected for your survivors will be marked in green.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/d310bce1138ba24124bd0512961ee0b01e3fca74.png


Additional New Features:
 New Achievement- Kill an Armored Enemy with a Chainsaw
 Added a Difficulty Selection choice to the start of the game


Balance Changes:
 Added a Dynamic Difficulty system, reducing zombie spawns when the player has died on that level previously, their barricade is at very low health, or there are multiple zombies attacking their barricade
 Generally overhauled zombie spawner settings and area map looting values across the board
 Survivor weapon shots are now only partially accurate instead of 100% accurate
 Reduced the maximum amount of damage that the barricade can take per second
 Slightly reduced time between shots for Eagle
 Slightly reduced time between shots for M16 bursts
 Slightly reduced the number and frequency of zombies that spawn in on the first level


Improvements:
 Fixed survivors fleeing into obstacles
 Reduced game install/download size by 800MB by optimizing Barricade, weapon and Zombie textures
 Fixed missing stump textures on Zombie Policeman
 Increase the thickness and visibility of weapon highlights on the Weapon Rack
 Made the graphical option selection descriptions easier to read


Given the number of new features added in this Update, its highly recommended that you start a brand new game instead of loading from a save game.

If you experience any bugs or need assistance with the game, please let us know on Discord or the Steam Discussion Forum. We'll be standing by to issue a patch in a few days to correct any bugs.

If you're an established content creator, media keys are available via Woovit.

A Note on Update 1.3:

With Update 1.2 released, we'll begin work on Update 1.3 - which will include new weapons, enemies, levels (Origins and Aftermath), and features. Update 1.3 is planned for release at the beginning of February. Once Update 1.3 is released, later this year we'll be releasing a final 1.4 Update specific for the PC version of the game, which will include 21:9 Ultra Widescreen support, some additional graphics options, and some other tweaks.

Please restart your Steam client to receive the update.


PATCH 1.21:
This small patch was released on the 12th December and includes some minor balance tweaks:

 Reduced the number of heavy and aggro zombies that spawn on Parking map
 Reduced the overall number of zombies which spawn on Parking map
 Dynamic Difficulty spawns in Zombies more slowly after a player death
 Increased Survivor weapon accuracy

notes.title: Patch 1.12 now live - Balance Adjustments
notes.content:
Update 1.12 is now live, with the following changes:

Balance:
Reduced the difficulty of the beginning Forest level
Easy mode is now easier: Zombie health reduced from 80% to 75%
Hard mode is now easier: Zombie health reduced from 125% to 110%
Luger capacity reduced from 8 to 7

Tweaks:
If a reload animation has played for 2 seconds or longer, the reload will be completed even if the animation did not fully play out (eg. when switching weapon or throwing a grenade).
Can view the controls from the ingame ESC menu
Separated Audio and Gameplay tabs in the Options menu


Update 1.2 development is proceeding well, and will be released later this month.

As always, if you experience any bugs, need technical help, or have any feedback, please contact us on our Steam Discussion Forum, or Discord.


Edit: we've pushed a small hotfix to fix the loading bug when joining coop. Please restart your Steam client and update the game if you still face this problem.

notes.title: Update 1.1 Now Available: Armored Zombies, Coop (+1.11 patch)
notes.content:
Update 1.1 for Frontline Zed is now available:

New Features:
 2-Player Coop - play through the original campaign with a friend. Play together on a local PC, or via Steam Remote Play. At least one player must use a controller. NPC survivors have been removed from this mode to increase the challenge, and make room for the second human player. Each player can choose a unique crosshair color and design.

Coop Mode required a lot of technical overhauls, and there are still a few tweaks and improvements we wish to make to it - if you have any feedback on Coop mode, please check this thread in our Steam forum,

 Armored Zombies - as you progress through the game, you'll be faced with tough, armored opponents - aim for the unprotected head area to deal more damage! Shots to the torso will still deal some damage, albeit a reduced amount.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/f31cbfb4e9324b7228ef407983b670234845c652.png

 New Achievement - Kill 10 Armored Zombies


Balance Changes:
 Tweaked the zombie spawn rates on all levels for a more challenging experience
 Increased the number of zombies that spawn when there are very few on the field
 Zombies now spawn in more distinct 'waves'
 Slightly increased Survivor weapon damage and fire rate
 L96 Sniper Rifle now penetrates 2 zombies, up from 1
 AKM damage slightly reduced
 Heavy Revolver rate of fire slightly increased


Improvements:
 Slight performance improvement when a lot of zombie ragdolls are onscreen
 Zombie ragdolls 90% less likely to glitch out


A Note on Update 1.2:

We've decided to move the Chainsaw and Explodable Barrels features to Update 1.2 - to allow more time to polish and enhance them. We expect Update 1.2 to be released at approximately the 20th of December.

Update 1.1 included a lot of major, behind the scenes updates to the game, to support the features coming in Update 1.2 and Update 1.3. As a result, there may be some bugs - we're standing by to issue a patch 1.11 in the next few days.

If you do experience any bugs, please let us know on Discord or the Steam Discussion Forum.

Please restart your Steam client to receive the update.


Patch 1.11
 Fixed Zombie ragdoll limit setting in Options menu. By default, zombie ragdolls will be limited to 30 instances.
 Further reduced number of runner zombies that spawn in when the barricade is at very low health
 Fixed new achievement not showing in Steam

notes.title: Frontline Zed Roadmap + Patch 1.03 Details
notes.content:
Edit: Patch 1.03 is now live!

Thanks for supporting Frontline Zed during launch week! In this announcement, we're unveiling the Roadmap, as well as detailing the 1.03 patch coming tomorrow.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/b593ca78d8a004b7b9b9e82eed96f9391de0b121.png
(Click Here for a larger image)

Roadmap Details:
Frontline Zed has been available for one week, and in that time we've accumulated a lot of very helpful feedback. Thanks! This Roadmap has been designed to satisfy the most requested features, whilst also being technically achievable enough that we can deliver updates as a steady pace.

We're going to be working hard to deliver one of these major updates per month, starting in November for Update 1.1. However, we will be carrying out extensive testing, including beta tests, and will hold back and refine an update if it is not ready.

If you would like to get a sneak-peek at these Updates as they are developed, and want to participate in beta testing, please join the Frontline Zed Official Discord channel.

If you have any feedback or questions about the Roadmap, you can also discuss it on our Steam Forum Thread.


Now, onto Patch 1.03, coming tomorrow:

Patch 1.03 Changelog:
FEATURES
 Can now move character with arrow keys, and switch weapon with spacebar
 Added Windowed Fullscreen mode to Options
 Added 1280x720 (16:9) resolution to Options


TWEAKS
 Slowed down camera pans when navigating to and within the Weapon section
 Improved the animation and design of text on the outro movie, and reduced its length
 Spawned bullets further inside the barrel, so that shooting zombies in close range is more reliable
 Made the English weapon names easier to read when using the Chinese language option
 Removed the blue lines of the diary to better fit Chinese characters when using the Chinese language option


BALANCE
 Tweaked the minimum and maximum time between shots for survivors.
 Reduced the number of runner zombies that spawn, when your barricade is at 10 or less health (including if destroyed)
 Made it easier to find new survivors when your current number of survivors is low (eg. after your barricade has been destroyed, but you survived)


BUGFIXES
 Save and Exit now clears previously looted buildings
 Made non-English text display more reliable and consistently across the game



Media Keys

Due to an error, keys sent via Keymailer have been deactivated. Please check this thread if you were impacted, to get a replacement.



That's all for today - there will be another update previewing Update 1.1 before it comes out.  Thanks again for all your support!

notes.title: Patch 1.02 Now Live + Patch 1.021 Languages Hotfix
notes.content:
Edit: Patch 1.021 is now live, with the following additional changes:


 Fixed Languages reverting to English when the main campaign is finished, or when the player exits back to the Menu
 Fixed being unable to change out of Portuguese language to another language
 Tweaked and improved the design of the Outro movie particularly in non-English languages (still some more to do here - we will redesign that entire section)
 Balanced the late-game AKM


Patch 1.02 is now live on Steam - please restart your Steam client to receive the update immediately.

Patch 1.02 Changelog:
Features:
 Can choose Crosshairs and customise colour (in Options menu)
 Survivors have slightly more powerful weapons now
 Hard difficulty added to Options (game still defaults to Medium difficulty) - zombie health increased by 20%
 Reduced game download size by 700MB


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35354567/f31c03ee468f88f6dbfbeb53b449e08ba03da438.jpg


Balance:
 Buff to UMP damage
 Warehouse level made easier
 M16 now has a gap between bursts


Bugfixes:
 Fixed quality level showing as Low when it was in fact higher
 Fixed movement keys changing weapon for AZERTY/French keyboard users
 Flawless Victory achievement fixed
 Q and E keys no longer change weapons (this was conflicting with certain keyboard setups)
 Spacebar button changes weapon (in addition to mouse wheel, '1' and '2' keys)
 Can now start a new game immediately after finishing the campaign




Next week, we will also reveal our Roadmap, for future patches, optimisation, more reliable game balance, and whole lot of new content! Your continued support helps make this future work possible.

If you need urgent support, have a bug report, or have a suggestion for the game, please visit our Steam Discussion forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/915490/discussions/

And Discord: https://discord.gg/s3HjzhZ

Thanks!

notes.title: Patch 1.02 Plans, Patch 1.01 notes + Thank you for a successful launch day!
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for supporting us during launch day! We've had some great feedback, and a lot of very happy responses, but also identified areas that we need to patch and improve. 

Our first patch for the game went live last night:

Patch 1.01 

 BUGFIX: The Looting Maps now show all buildings in the correct language
 BUGFIX: The final Outro video now has working fonts and statistics (and looks much less ugly, sorry about the bugged old version!)
 BALANCE: The first three levels (Forest, Farm, Junkyard) are slightly easier, to help players ease into the game


And we're working now on Patch 1.02, hopefully coming today:

 FEATURE: Change crosshair color and design in Options menu
 BUGFIX: Changed 'change weapons' keys from Q+E, to Spacebar (and retained 1+2 keys, and mouse wheel) to fix problems AZERTY keyboard players had with movement changing weapons
 BALANCE: Added 'hard' difficulty mode, with zombies with 20% stronger health. We're still tweaking this difficulty level, so we welcome your feedback. 
 BALANCE: Survivors in later areas use more powerful weapons


We're working hard all week and weekend to respond to your feedback, and will be preparing more patches to fix important issues. 

After that, we have a lot more free content planned for the game - so please stay tuned!

If you need immediate support, please contact us on our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/s3HjzhZ

To share your feedback or offer suggestions for future patches, please visit our Steam Discussions page: https://steamcommunity.com/app/915490/discussions/
